messages.subject: For Brent Bergeron | Corporate affairs, sustainability and Americas stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Fisekci,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Brent Bergeron, Senior Vice President, Corporate Affairs and Sustainability.

Pan American Silver's footprint across the Americas makes the integration of government relations, community engagement, sustainability and country risk especially important. That is the same operating interface in which I have built my leadership experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I also support stakeholder governance around industrial renewable-energy infrastructure and carbon-accounting evidence work.

I would value a conversation about where this operating-side experience might support Pan American Silver's corporate-affairs, sustainability, social-performance or country-facing leadership priorities across the Americas. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
